claim: In the cited Google and Jegham sources, WUE is water used per unit of IT energy, and Google's paper specifies the consumptive-use variant of WUE.
displayValue: Water used per unit of IT energy
comparisonContext: This matters because many public comparisons talk about water without defining what part of the system is being counted.
scopeNote: The site should keep clear whether WUE refers to consumptive use and whether figures are facility-only or broader water footprints.
sourceTitle: Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google Scale
